meaning: An explicit reconciled compilation selection adapts the existing source and compiled-project build entry points to the same checked project and exact local output receipt, without changing legacy calls or inventing assurance.
selection: The fifth argument of planProjectBuild and planCompiledProjectBuild, and sixth argument of verifyProjectBuild, is an optional authored compilation selection. Omission preserves the existing legacy return type and behavior. Explicit selection is decoded before source access; language and any numeric realization must agree, and unsupported output layouts reject without fallback.
planning: Source builds retain final source-currentness checking. Compiled builds consume only the registered snapshot and never reload source files. Both produce the same immutable, registered reconciled build wrapper containing the exact whole-project artifact view and unchanged output receipt.
publication: publishProjectBuild recognizes the selected wrapper and delegates only its registered checked project to the common output publisher. Cloned, spread, tampered or foreign-schema selected plans reject before output mutation; selected wrappers never enter the legacy publisher.
verification: verifyProjectBuild with explicit selection reconstructs the selected expected build and delegates to exact artifact-currentness verification. Its result retains the distinct reconciled schema and explicitly says native compilation, semantic observation and formal verification were not performed.
cli: Selected whole-project build and verify commands use these public wrappers; qualified-node currentness verification continues to use the common exact node view.
separation: Architectural selection, numeric realization and output layout remain separate parameters. This adapter does not enable an unsupported application layout or graph composition and does not alter the compiler source capsule or generated artifact bytes.
non_effects: native or formal verification by receipt comparison
